about: Lines the owner graded in batch 2 or 3 that a later pass rewrote with his lessons (owner, Nov 9, batch 3 by voice): the key and the text as he graded it. The batch tests accept a bank line that matches this text instead of the shipped one. A key listed under deleted is a line a later pass removed outright (the journal's "after ... out of work" lines, which became small stories): his grade stays in the grade file and the ledger, and no piece is left to weigh. Lines the Nov 17 cut deleted (the owner: "JUST DELETE EVERYTHING THAT IT HASNT WRITTEN") are listed under deleted the same way.
